# 2026 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors football team

The 2026 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors football team will represent the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa (Hawaiʻi or UH) in the Mountain West Conference (MW) during the 2026 NCAA Division I FBS football season. The Rainbow Warriors are led by Timmy Chang in his fifth year as the program's head coach. The Rainbow Warriors play home games at the Clarence T. C. Ching Athletics Complex, located in Honolulu, Hawaii.
